it is hereby notified for the public information that it has been decided under the resolution number 01-03 held on 20.11.2023 that the roads and lanes included in the following schedule should be declared as roads and lanes owned by the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha, in terms of the functions assigned to the Pradeshiya Sabha in the North Western Province by the series of "Orders regarding the preparation of plans for the roads and lanes maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabhas in the North Western Province and the publication of advertisements showing the names of roads and lanes” published by the Hon. Governor, North Western Province in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2238/35 dated 30th July 2021 to be read with Section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987.

It is further notified that, if it is the opinion of the claimant party that any road or lane included in that Schedule will pass through any land or part of a land, action should be taken to file a case in a proper court within three months from the date of this notification is published in order to confirm his ownership of that land.

It is further notified that all the roads and lanes included in the schedule for which cases have not been filed in the Court before the expiry of the said three months period will be considered as roads and lanes owned by the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha. D. D. Wickramasinghe, Secretarial and Powers Function, Implementation Officer, Pradeshiya Sabha Polgahawela.

Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha proposes that the roads and lanes mentioned in the list included in the following schedule should be considered as roads and lanes maintained by the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha under the provisions of the series of "Orders regarding the preparation of plans for the roads and lanes maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha’s in the North Western Province and the publication of advertisements showing the names of roads and lanes” published by the Hon. Governor, North Western Province in the Extraordinary Gazette Notification No. 2238/35 dated 30th July 2021, and the provisions of Section 24 (1) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act No. 15 of 1987. I, the Secretary of Polgahawela local council decide according to decision number 1-03 dated 20.11.2023.
